name: Seedcheek · Gremlet #7
description:
A dwarf hamster whose cheeks are always stuffed with snacks it's saving for later.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Seedcheek in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
